title_en: Chinese Humor (7/20): The Great Red Envelope War
note_en: 一A就B means "as soon as A, B": the second action follows the first almost instantly. 红包一出现，他一秒就能抢到 "the moment a red envelope appears, he grabs it within a second"; 一到抢红包的时候，全家就没人好好吃饭了 "once red envelope time comes, nobody eats properly." Note the word order: 一 and 就 both go right before their verbs, after the subjects, unlike English "as soon as," which opens the clause.
